field_status_legend.measured: value present and passed validation -- render normally
field_status_legend.absent_upstream: upstream did not send this key -- gray out, 'awaiting upstream'
field_status_legend.null_upstream: upstream sent the key with a null/empty value -- gray out, 'no reading'
field_status_legend.field_error: value was rejected by validation and stored NULL -- gray out, show error
